items.heading: Tavce Gravce
details: Key ingredients: beans, paprika, onion, mint
Soak and simmer beans until nearly tender.
Saute onion with paprika until fragrant.
Combine the beans and onion mixture in a clay dish.
Bake until the top forms a light crust, finishing with fresh mint.

items.heading: Ajvar
details: Key ingredients: roasted red peppers, eggplant, garlic, oil
Roast red peppers and eggplant until the skins blacken.
Peel and puree the roasted vegetables with garlic.
Cook the puree slowly in oil, stirring often.
Simmer until thick and deeply flavored, then cool and serve as a spread.

items.heading: Macedonian Kebapi
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Shopska Salad
details: Ingredients: fresh vegetables/herbs, dressing, salt and optional grains/legumes.
Chop ingredients finely, whisk the dressing, combine just before serving and adjust acidity and salt.
